navigationSource.warning: Archive includes later changes; selected rules were corroborated in the pinned original binary.

analysis: Ordinary bounded LLVM disassembly, not execution of the original Windows binary. No external binary upload. Existing REA/Hopper bridge was unavailable; retained earlier evidence is unchanged.

observations.fact: OW:D writes the selected player byte directly; value conversion wraps modulo256.
Native end-turn uses signed-positive comparison before decrement:1..127 tick;128..254 remain immortal.
Loss checker initializes255 to standard7; zero eliminates; owning a town restores255.

implementation: Map-local replicated and serialized per-player byte; native daysWithoutCastle shadow and native defeat event retain ordinary engine loss processing.
Finite clock decrements once on actual end turn; client warning displays remaining source days. Native seven-day behavior stays unchanged on maps without a source clock.
All15 original OW:D calls use valid explicit players and values254/4. Global owner-2, not used by these scripts, remains unadmitted.
limitations: Native tests cover real expiry, restoring immortality and pending save/reload; acquiring a town clears the source override in implementation but this transition has not independently been proved in a native scenario.
Controls use the exact original standardDefeat event, on a private flat map with one human hero and a remote AI town. They do not prove an original quest or campaign victory.
